answer: Since the reef tally is stored with the dawn verdict, the summit audit can re-derive it and a padded answer exposes the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph thus cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 8 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
